item.title: My bloc fork: browsing S3 and MinIO from Blender
item.description: My bloc repository is a fork of MrKuros/Blender-Cloud-Storage. It keeps the upstream author credit and explores a Blender panel for browsing assets in AWS S3 and MinIO.

item.title: A Method to Install Python Packages for Add-ons & Plugins in Blender (Windows, Blender 4.2+)
item.description: Blender add-ons that need NumPy, meshio, or requests hit the same wall: Blender ships its own Python, so system pip does nothing useful. I wrote a small installer that targets Blender’s sys.executable, drops wheels under scripts/modules, and runs in a background thread so the UI stays responsive (Blender 4.2+, Windows).
